note: Base (8453) infrastructure: pool managers, factories, quoters, routers, position managers, launchpad factories/hooks, bonding curves, LP lockers and quote currencies. Never a holder, never a deployer. Every entry was verified 2026-10-29 on https://base-rpc.publicnode.com (archive lookups on https://base.gateway.tenderly.co / https://base.drpc.org): eth_getCode non-empty (size given) plus the role-proving call, log or tx named in identifiedBy. Names that could not be proven on-chain say so. Discovery: factory() of every pool GeckoTerminal lists for BRETT, the hook of every Uniswap v4 Initialize log in the last 400k blocks, and the creation tx / first mint of real tokens (docs/chains/base.md).
